g.text: Dimensions from the current CAD. Placement study, not a pin-by-pin soldering template.
1 Component side of the 70 × 50 mm board
Landscape on the existing vertical panel; component side faces the shell.
A: R1, R2, C1 battery sensing. B: R5, R6, R7, D3 sensor interface.
B stays ≤3 mm high; the last 5 mm stays empty to clear a passing shell boss.
Dashed squares: 9 mm mounting keep-outs. Other boxes reserve working space.
C2 box allows 30 × 18 mm including bent leads; actual part size is unpublished.
Pump and bottle are the existing CAD envelopes.
Red: shell retaining bosses. Their paths must stay clear during removal.
Gold: board and central capacitor space. Grey: existing support panel.
Body bore Ø179.2 mm. Wires, cradles and fasteners omitted for clarity.
3 Under the deck — new battery body
Separate CAD PR: enlarge the pocket and keep the deck height initially.
Bottom edge 2 mm above deck; 70 mm edge horizontal.
About 26 mm at the middle, 19 mm at the outer ends.
Central C2 ≤18 mm projection; MOSFETs ≤22 mm.
Keep tall parts away from the end beside the 140° boss.
25 mm pack leaves 17 mm below the existing deck.
Actual C2, buck, pump, plug and assembled cable sizes.
